Seven steps

One thread.
No chaos.

The birds stay at the top. The application moves downward as a quiet thread: signal, CV, match, proof, apply, prepare, done.

01Signal

Find the role worth applying to.

Start from the job, not from a blank prompt. Capture company, requirements, constraints and the reason this one matters.

02CV

Make the document true and clean.

Import the resume, fix the structure, keep the facts, remove noise. ATS-readable, human-readable, calm.

03Match

Map the strongest proof.

Connect role requirements to actual experience. Mark the gaps before the recruiter does.

04Proof

Draft what you can defend.

Cover letter, proposal, resume bullets. Every claim comes from the same private context layer.

05Apply

Send the next clean package.

One export, one application, then the next. No dashboard theater. No corporate productivity cosplay.

06Prepare

Walk in with the answers ready.

Interview prep follows the same thread: their questions, your evidence, your language.

07Done

The work is done.

Offer signed. Friday appears. Go play outside.

two weeks

Finish.
Faster.

Keep the birds as the mark. Let the scroll become the system: a thread that turns the job hunt into seven calm moves.
